_model: SID runs the tag-based Belt Engine, NOT pipeline stages, for lead state. The dashboard funnel is counted from custom DATE fields and two SINGLE_OPTIONS outcome fields, never from pipeline stage. Client association is a custom FIELD (partner_acronym), not a stage tag. See SID_System_Documentation.md.
_clientField: Contacts are classified to a client agency by this custom field value (the partner acronym), not by a per-client stage tag. This is the key difference from the generic kit.
_divisions: One row per client agency, keyed by partner acronym (uppercase key, lowercase acronym in field values and {acronym}booked tags). 38 acronyms were extracted from GHL tags. ACTIVE vs CHURNED and full agency names are PENDING confirmation from Robert/Eva; only HHC and LPC names are known. Provisionally all active so classification works; prune once the roster is confirmed.
_eventDateFields: The funnel is counted by these DATE custom fields inside the window, cumulative. Values are GHL fieldKeys; the pull resolves them. showDate and wonDate have NO date field in SID: Held is read from the Client Call Outcome field, and Won lives downstream in client sub-accounts (out of scope for this board).
_outcomeFields: SID tracks booked/held/DQ through SINGLE_OPTIONS outcome fields, not stages. Booked = Intro Call Outcome is Booked (or bookedDate set). Held = Client Call Outcome is Complete. Won is not tracked in SID.
_bookedAppointment: The live booked signal. 'Is booked appointment?' is toggled Yes when an appointment is booked; that is the source of truth (the sid_* outcome fields are not being written). dateField windows the booking; bookedBy attributes it to a setter. yesValues are matched case-insensitively.
_attemptFields: attemptCount is the true bundle count (one double-dial pair = +1), incremented by WF-2 via the sid-dial-1 toggle. dayOneAttemptCount has no field: it is computed as first attempt within 24h of leadDate. dials are NOT available (GHL native dialer, no Wavv API), so the dials column renders null and the integrity check watches for stuck sid-dial-1 tags instead.
_attemptIntegrity: The full bundle (double dial + VM + email + SMS = one attempt) is only PARTIALLY built: just the double-dial toggle is wired. There is no dials feed, so dials-per-attempt cannot be computed. The integrity check instead flags contacts stuck with a sid-dial-1 tag (a dial pair that never completed), which is the real failure mode.

connectedCall._note: A connect = an outbound call over 15 seconds, which auto-claims the lead (stamps sid_assigned_to and sid_assigned_at server-side). firstConnectDate maps to sid_assigned_at.

_calls: The sid_* call mirror fields (sid_assigned_at, sid_last_call_duration_sec, sid_attempt_count) are not being written, so dials/connects/talk-time are read directly from GHL conversation call messages instead (the authoritative feed, since setters dial from the CRM). windowDays bounds how far back call messages are pulled to keep the message-pull runtime sane; call metrics on windows longer than this understate totals and the board flags it. connectMinSec matches connectedCall.minDurationSec: an outbound completed call at or over it counts as a connect.
_introCallForm: The single write path for the floor. Attribution key is the Submitted By dropdown. NOTE a real mismatch: the form's Submitted By options (Michelle, Sarah, Heart, May, Sophia) do not match the GHL user roster or the Assigned To options. Heart and Sophia are not GHL users; Kyla, Mary and Johnny are users but not on the form. This must be reconciled or per-setter numbers will split across names.

introCallForm._note: Outcome values must match this list exactly. The board buckets by them.

_tierTags: The Belt Engine priority tiers. A contact carries one active tier tag at a time; a connected call removes all tier tags (the lead is claimed). These drive the queue lanes, mapped to the board's four lanes below.
_queueLaneMap: PROPOSED mapping of the 8 belt tiers onto the board's four priority lanes. Please confirm. P5 archive and DNC are excluded from the queue on purpose.
_operationalTags: Non-tier tags used by the workflows.

Two duplicate pipelines (Michelle DSDR k9ZjeXcN1wk9vkfK2Fqu, SDR Asana Clone 4sWUMqsJU8FRQQHxYZ34) are pending consolidation. Won is not tracked in SID, so the board's Signed column is downstream/out of scope.

_users: SID user IDs to display names. Attribution on the Setters tab is by the form Submitted By value, which uses FIRST names and does not line up with this roster (see introCallForm note). Johnny is a user but not on either dropdown.
_activeSetters: The current SDR floor (confirmed). The Setters tab shows exactly these, keyed by Intro Call Form Submitted By. Michelle and Sarah also map to GHL users (Michelle Supina, Sarah Sanchez) and are fully attributed on the claim side. Heart and Sophia have NO GHL user and are not in the Assigned To dropdown, so only their form activity attributes until they are added to Assigned To in SID.

alerts._note: Confirmed channel. P1 leads and SLA breaches push here. Never include PHI or free-text notes: contact first name, last initial, client acronym, and the SID deep link only.

dialer.legacy: Wavv power dialer (tags wavv-smartlist, powerdial on 1400+ contacts)
dialer._note: No dial-count API is wired, so the Dials column stays null. WF-2 fires on GHL Call Details (Completed + Outgoing); Wavv calls only count if Wavv syncs events back to GHL.

webhook._note: Stateless Convex/Vercel service. Handles tier_transition and call_answered events, writes calculated fields back to GHL, and logs to the redundancy spreadsheet. Reference only; the board does not call it.

hours._note: SDR floor is 7 days a week, 10:00 to 22:00 EST. The speed-to-lead SLA clock pauses outside these hours. The belt engine itself runs 24/7.

ads._note: Facebook Lead Forms feed SID via ~40 per-client intake workflows. Per-client ad spend and ROAS are v2 and belong on the front-end engine board, not this one.
